episodeTitle.en: The rituals of great teams | Shishir Mehrotra, Coda, YouTube, Microsoft
episodeTitle.zh: 优秀团队的仪式感 | 希希尔·梅赫罗特拉，Coda，YouTube，微软

guestBioOfficial.en: Shishir Mehrotra is the co-founder and CEO of Coda, and formerly head of product and engineering at YouTube. In this episode, he shares his insights on growth strategy, how he evaluates talent, a peek at his upcoming book The Rituals of Great Teams, why reference checks are the most important step in the interview process, and so much more. Join us.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 希希尔·梅赫罗特拉（Shishir Mehrotra）是Coda的联合创始人兼CEO，曾任YouTube产品与工程部门负责人。本期节目中，他将分享自己对增长战略的见解、如何评估人才、对其即将出版的《优秀团队的仪式感》一书的展望、为何背景调查是面试过程中最重要的一环等诸多观点。欢迎收听。

title.en: The rituals of great teams | Shishir Mehrotra, Coda, YouTube, Microsoft
title.zh: 优秀团队的仪式感 | 希希尔·梅赫罗特拉，Coda，YouTube，微软

summary.en: Shishir shares how Coda builds product and culture, including its famous 'operating principles' and approaches to docs-as-products. He discusses lessons from scaling YouTube, how to create alignment through shared principles rather than process, and why building a new category requires patience and a clear point of view. The episode offers a thoughtful look at founder-led product philosophy.
summary.zh: Shishir 分享了 Coda 如何打造产品与文化，包括其著名的“运营原则（operating principles）”以及“文档即产品”的思路。他讨论了规模化 YouTube 的经验、如何通过共享原则而非流程来达成对齐，以及为何开辟新品类需要耐心与清晰的立场。本期对创始人驱动的产品哲学给出了富有思考的透视。
